column1: # The sources of data/vocab.tsv: one row per source file, tab-separated.
# tools/check-vocab.sh downloads the fetched rows and checks that the list is
# what they and data/vocab-patches.tsv give; npm run vocab writes the list.
# prefix     the vocabulary's prefix; a vocabulary with more than one file
#            repeats it, and its rows agree on namespace and aliases
# namespace  the namespace its terms are checked in
# aliases    other spellings of the namespace, separated by spaces, or -
# format     ttl, nt or rdfxml: fetched from url; tsv: frozen, read from
#            data/vocab-frozen/<prefix>.tsv, an extract of the list's term
#            lines (url then names the publisher's file it was compared with)
# url        https; a release, tag, commit or versioned file where the
#            publisher has one, else its current file
# version    what the publisher calls the release; for a frozen row, also when
# licence    the licence the publisher gives it
# sha256     the hash of the bytes the generator reads; a publisher's change to
#            an unversioned file shows as a changed hash
# A correction (a term the publisher defines elsewhere) goes in
# data/vocab-patches.tsv with its reason, never into a frozen extract.
